title: Blueprint Fabricator
body:
"Converts multiple schematics into one singular schematic that can be replaced anywhere on your property. Has a limit of 1.500 schematics!"

Description

The Blueprint Fabricator can be purchased from The Oak Depot for $12,500.

Uses Blueprints, which can be found at The Oak Depot to create custom ones.

The blueprint fabricator can be used to save the data of a build in the design region to blueprints, which can then be either learned for copying around your base or for selling to other players. Any build can include at most 500 schematics in it.

Trivia

The Blueprint Fabricator can now hold up to 500 schematics, where as previously it could only hold up to 250 when it was first introduced in update V.1.58.1.
